learning_outcomes.text: Ability to define a complex engineering problem, determine an analysis method for its solution, and design the system or product to be presented
Ability to use appropriate tools and collect and process necessary data for complex problem analysis and solution
Ability to participate effectively in project work, write and present technical reports
Ability to follow developments in science and technology while solving complex problems, awareness of acting in accordance with standards and ethical principles
Ability to plan the project process, allocate tasks, use time and resources effectively, and evaluate project outcomes in accordance with the defined objectives.

syllabus_topics: Source Research and Literature Review / Classification and Analysis of Sources
Determination of Tools and Methods to be Used
bibliography: Publications, books and other materials related to the project
